INSERTSTAVKEFORM.CAPTION: Ugovor s kupcem
INSERTSTAVKEFORM.ONLOAD:
update kupugovorigla set operaterlock=@@operateriid where kupugovoriglaid=@@id
select top(1) k.kupugovoriglaid as kupugovoriglaid, k.broj as broj, k.Opis as opis, k.Osobeid as osobeid, k.partneriid as partneriid, k.datumugovora as datumugovora, k.UgovorVrijediDo as ugovorvrijedido, k.orgshemaid as orgshemaid, k.parziroid as parziroid, (rtrim(o.Ime)+' '+ltrim(o.Prezime)) as ImePrezime, p.naziv as Firma, k.parstruid as lokacija, ps.naziv as parstru, k.KupUgovoriVrsteId as KupUgovoriVrsteId, k.Napomena as GlaNapomena from KupUgovoriGla k left join Osobe o on k.OsobeId=o.OsobeId left join partneri p on k.PartneriId=p.partneriid
left outer join parstru ps on ps.parstruid=k.parstruid order by KupUgovoriGlaId desc

select 'disable' as broj, 'disable' as datumugovora, 'diasble' as UgovorVrijediDo, 'disable' as opis, 'disable' as osobeid , 'disable' as orgshemaid, 'disable' as spremi, 'disable' as partneriid, 'disable' as parziroid, 'disable' as dodaj, 'disable' as izmjeni, 'disable' as obriši, 'disable' as stavke, 'disable' as GlaNapomena
